top_signals.title: Oil Majors Seek Bigger Bargaining Power in Labor Disputes
top_signals.summary: The biggest oil companies in the United States are playing hardball in unionized labor negotiations in a bid to get more concessions from workers’ unions in the new contracts. Over the past few years, some of the top U.S. refining companies have resorted to lockouts to ensure most of the company management’s proposals in new labor contracts are accepted.
